summary: Iteration 5 — Validated Antidote/desktop-tool clipboard whitelist bug fix. Backend: 5 new pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_examsecure_v5.py cover clipboard_tool (counted=False), fullscreen_exit_tool (counted=False), paste_attempt still counted when tool is allowed (statement area), paste_attempt counted when no tools allowed (regression), and teacher visibility of both event types. All 5 pass. Full regression suite 62/62 PASS. Frontend E2E (Playwright on preview URL): (a) Antidote-allowed redaction exam -> dispatched ClipboardEvent('paste') on [data-testid=exam-rich-editor] -> NO 'Signalement' toast, session.violations stayed 0, session.events contains ('clipboard_tool', counted=false). (b) Regression no-tool exam -> same paste -> 'Signalement 1/3 : A tenté de coller' toast appears, violations=1, event ('paste_attempt', counted=true). RichEditor handlePaste gating via allowPaste prop works: when desktopAllowed non-empty the editor accepts the paste and useAntiCheat emits non-counted clipboard_tool via data-answer-zone check.

issues: Review request mentions a data-testid='desktop-tools-notice' element that should appear when a desktop tool is enabled; this testid is NOT present in SettingsPanel.jsx. The free-text explanation at line 67 references Antidote/WordQ/Lexibar but is static (always visible), not a conditional notice. Low priority — functionality works, only the testid/conditional UI is missing.

action_items: Optional: add a conditional <div data-testid='desktop-tools-notice'> in SettingsPanel.jsx that renders only when settings.allowed_tools includes a desktop tool, informing the teacher that clipboard inside the answer zone will be allowed. This was mentioned in the review request but not implemented.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py COUNTED_EVENTS does NOT include 'clipboard_tool' or 'fullscreen_exit_tool' — correct; backend returns counted=false for both regardless of exam settings. Behavior is uniform and safe.

useAntiCheat.js emit() has a 1500ms dedupe window for COUNTED types and now also for 'clipboard_tool'. Good — rapid Antidote double-paste won't flood events. However dedupe for non-counted events could hide legitimate repeated activity in the teacher log; acceptable trade-off.

useAntiCheat.js onClip gate: `desktopAllowed.length && e.target?.closest?.('[data-answer-zone]')`. Note e.target can be a text node in some browsers; .closest handles that fine. The check uses `desktopAllowed.length` (number of allowed desktop tools) which is truthy if ANY desktop tool is allowed — matches backend `desktop_ok` logic for antidote/wordq/lexibar.

RichEditor.jsx handlePaste returns `!allowPaste` to prevent default pasting when allowPaste=false. When allowPaste=true (desktop tool allowed), tiptap handles paste normally and useAntiCheat emits clipboard_tool. Clean integration.

ExamBody.jsx computes allowPaste from allowed_tools filtered to antidote/wordq/lexibar — matches backend. Short-answer Input also has data-answer-zone so clipboard_tool fires there too — covered by hook (not editor-specific).

fullscreen_exit_tool is emitted in useAntiCheat when toolActive() OR desktopAllowed.length — reasonable but note that any desktop-tool-allowed exam will NEVER emit the counted fullscreen_exit (since desktopAllowed.length is truthy). This is the intended behavior per the spec but worth confirming with product.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — both antidote-allow and no-tool regression flows verified end-to-end on the preview URL

seed_data_creation: Transient test exams prefixed TEST_V5_ were created and deleted during tests. No residual data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend exam create expects fields: title, exam_type (NOT 'type'), writing_prompt (NOT 'items'), settings{allowed_tools,...}; code is server-generated and returned in response (ignore client-provided code). Student join body uses student_name (not 'name'). Session token is stored in localStorage/sessionStorage under a key matching /token/i. To exercise paste in the editor use page.evaluate dispatching a ClipboardEvent with DataTransfer-populated clipboardData on element [data-testid=exam-rich-editor]. Preview URL: https://exam-guard-37.preview.emergentagent.com.
rca of the issue: N/A — bug fix is implemented correctly on both backend (clipboard_tool/fullscreen_exit_tool excluded from COUNTED_EVENTS) and frontend (RichEditor.allowPaste prop + useAntiCheat data-answer-zone gating). Verified end-to-end.
